snippet.title: From the basketball court to building SuperYou together, here’s how it all began :)  #besuperyou
snippet.description:
How did SuperYou start? On the court. With a dunk. And a 2-slide deck. 🏀💥

From a heated basketball match to building India’s boldest protein brand — this is how Nikunj offered Ranveer a partnership for SuperYou… mid-game! No boardroom. No suits. Just sweat, shots, and a 2-slide presentation.
